About.p1: I'm a Senior Software Developer with over 10 years of experience building production systems across the Netherlands and Egypt. My work has spanned survey platform modernization at scale (Metrixlab/Toluna), medical application development at ICT Group, food-delivery integrations at Talabat, and internal enterprise tooling — from junior developer all the way to leading cross-functional teams.
About.p2: My core stack is .NET/C# on the backend, with React and TypeScript on the frontend. I've worked with microservices on AWS Lambda, modernized legacy systems from VB6 and MVC to clean service-oriented architectures, and built real-time event pipelines with Kafka. I care about maintainability, integration reliability, and delivering things that actually work under production conditions.
About.p3: Based in Schiedam, the Netherlands. I work in English, Arabic, and Dutch. I'm actively integrating AI-assisted workflows into my daily engineering — using tools like Claude Code and GitHub Copilot to sharpen code quality and move faster without cutting corners.
